_about: Apple's accessory protocol (AAP, which LibrePods calls AACP) as PairFree uses it with AirPods and Beats on Apple's chips, from LibrePods (github.com/kavishdevar/librepods, GPL-3.0-or-later: AACPManager, docs/) and MagicPodsCore (github.com/steam3d/MagicPodsCore, GPL-3.0: sdk/aap). A packet is the header, a two-byte opcode (low byte first) and data; a control command is opcode 09 with a one-byte id and four bytes of value (docs/apple/PROTOCOL.md). never_send lists what PairFree never sends.

controls.name: mic_mode
controls.note: Which AirPod's microphone is used (LibrePods' MicrophoneSettingsScreen).

controls.name: listening_mode_configs
controls.note: The modes press and hold cycles through: 01 off, 02 noise cancelling, 04 transparency, 08 adaptive. LibrePods keeps at least two.

controls.name: chime_volume
controls.note: The tone volume, then 50 hex as LibrePods writes it (AccessibilitySettingsScreen).

controls.name: call_management
controls.note: 00, then 03 (press once to mute, twice to hang up) or 02 (the other way round), LibrePods' CallControlScreen.

controls.name: crown_reversed
controls.note: AirPods Max: 01 turns the Digital Crown the other way, 02 the default.

opcodes.10: smart routing, which takes the AirPods over from other devices
